items.title: Actual cosine-grid precision admissibility

source.anchor: S4.E11 literal hard precision; S4.Thmtheorem6 Lemma4.6; AppendixC.4 A3.SS4 selected matrix admissibility and actual Gaussian target context.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling, Eq11/Lemma4.6. ASTIS exposes the scalar/diagonal/conjugation bridges and the strict positivity consequence.
source.scope: Actual pointwise precision sandwich and produced PosDef; real Test consumes it in an actual Gaussian law-density equality. Full C4 and main lower bounds remain separate.

items.statement: Every actual cosine-grid precision lies between the identity and κ times the identity and is positive definite. I_d\preceq A\preceq\kappa I_d,\qquad A\succ0. \(d\in\mathbb N,\ d\ge2,\ \kappa\in\mathbb R,\ \kappa\ge2\). Fix any actual \(O\in O(d)\), including either determinant sign. The assertion holds pointwise; no Haar law or private-randomness premise is needed. For source indices \(i=1,\ldots,d\), let \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+(\kappa-1)\cos\theta_i/2\), and \(A=O\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)O^\top\). Lean uses zero-based \(i.\mathrm{val}+1/2\); the focused Test proves that index alignment. Matrix order is quadratic-form order: \(I_d\preceq A\) means \(A-I_d\) is positive semidefinite, and \(A\preceq\kappa I_d\) means \(\kappa I_d-A\) is positive semidefinite. This does not require every entry to be nonnegative. The finite-support definition covers all real coordinate vectors. Positive definiteness, symmetry, scalar interval bounds and both orthogonality identities are produced or obtained from the source orthogonal-group input; none is a new public hypothesis. The dimension premise is retained exactly even though the cosine envelope works for every angle. The actual Gaussian consumer is \(\pi_A=N(0,A^{-1})\) on Euclidean space with Lebesgue reference volume and real exponent \(d/2\), including odd dimensions. Its positive precision comes from this producer. Known-normalizer products independent of \(O\), full Appendix C.4 calculus/minimizer, moments/Krylov, adaptive/precision/cost/TV adapters and both complete main bounds remain separate.
